name: Progress
summary: A determinate progress indicator — completion, upload, a quiz timer — as a line, segmented steps, or a circle.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-progress> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Progress is a family, not one bar: `type` picks the shape (`line` horizontal bar · `circle` SVG ring), `steps` splits a line into discrete segments, `size` is default or `small` (the Mini variants), and `status` recolours the fill (active/success/warning/exception). `percent` drives a PERSISTENT fill node — the line's width or the ring's stroke-dashoffset — so it animates on the shared motion tokens; the shape is never rebuilt on a percent/status change. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens → byte-identical in React and Vue. Zero drift — the same element, not look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin attribute wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Fill
spec.value: default primary #6A1EBB · width (line) or stroke-dashoffset (circle) = percent

spec.label: Steps
spec.value: steps=N → N equal segments, first round(percent) filled

spec.label: Info
spec.value: percent label (✓/✕ glyph at success/exception); hide with show-info=false

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: role=progressbar · aria-valuemin 0 / valuemax 100 / valuenow synced to percent

props.name: percent
props.desc: Completion 0–100; clamped and drives the fill

props.name: type
props.desc: Shape: horizontal bar or SVG ring

props.name: steps
props.desc: Split a line into N discrete segments (line type only)

props.name: size
props.desc: Compact Mini variant (thinner bar / smaller ring)

props.name: show-info
props.desc: Show the trailing percent/glyph label (set 'false' to hide)

whenToUse.when: a determinate task with a known percentage (upload, steps, a timer)
an indeterminate wait with no measurable percentage
content is loading and you want to hold its layout

opinion.note: Use Progress only when you can measure completion. A line for inline flow, steps for a discrete multi-stage task, a circle for a compact score dial. Let the fill colour carry success/exception, not a separate label. For an indeterminate wait use Spin.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Progress component-set taxonomy: Progress line (Bare · Status Success/Exception), Progress-Line-Mini (small size · Success/Exception), Progress-Circle + Progress-Circle-Mini (Status Normal/Success/Exception), Progress-Step (Default/Small). i.e. the family carries type (line · circle), size (default · Mini/small), steps, and status (normal/success/exception; antd adds active/warning). No measured px cell exists; sizes/colours derived from the token layer (fill color-primary + status color-success/warning/error, track gray-30, radius-pill) and antd Progress conventions (8px line, trailing percent). A deliberate, documented extension.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The [data-probe] is a default LINE bar so the base measure holds; a second element asserts the exception status colour.
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-progress[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;var f=r&&r.querySelector('.fill');var t=r&&r.querySelector('.track');var sf=f?getComputedStyle(f):null;var st=t?getComputedStyle(t):null;var ex=document.querySelector('aha-progress[status="error"]')||document.querySelector('aha-progress[status="exception"]');var exr=ex&&ex.shadowRoot;var exf=exr&&exr.querySelector('.fill');var sef=exf?getComputedStyle(exf):null;return{fillBg:sf?sf.backgroundColor:null,trackBg:st?st.backgroundColor:null,height:st?st.height:null,radius:st?st.borderTopLeftRadius:null,role:el?el.getAttribute('role'):null,ariaNow:el?el.getAttribute('aria-valuenow'):null,ariaMax:el?el.getAttribute('aria-valuemax'):null,exceptionFillBg:sef?sef.backgroundColor:null};})()
